results.name: Repeated-evidence top-three causal-module coverage
results.hypothesis: Top-three causal-module coverage is more reliable when every counted directional target has at least two extracted evidence items.
results.body: R246 with drug-decrease evidence count at least two for each counted target
results.mechanism_rationale: Repeated directional evidence strengthens each intervention arm, although repeated extractions may originate from one publication.
results.trapi_notes: The positive paths are TRAPI-expressible; evidence count, rank, cardinality, and ontology constraints require post-processing.
results.cypher:
MATCH (subject:Drug)-[binding:DIRECTLY_PHYSICALLY_INTERACTS_WITH]->
      (gene:Gene)
MATCH (subject)-[effect:AFFECTS]->(gene)
MATCH (gene)-[evidence:MINER_GENE_DISEASE_EVIDENCE]->(object:Disease)
WHERE effect.qualified_predicate = 'biolink:causes'
  AND effect.object_aspect_qualifier = 'activity_or_abundance'
  AND effect.object_direction_qualifier = 'decreased'
  AND evidence._miner_disease_rank <= 3
  AND coalesce(object._miner_disease_descendant_degree, 0) <= 500
  AND object._miner_disease_superclass_degree >= 1
  AND object.id STARTS WITH 'MONDO:'
  AND coalesce(
        effect.evidence_count,
        size(coalesce(effect.publications, [])),
        1
      ) >= 2


WITH subject, object, count(DISTINCT gene) AS targeted_genes
WHERE targeted_genes >= 2
RETURN DISTINCT subject.id AS subject_id, object.id AS object_id

results.name: Distinct-publication top-three causal-module coverage
results.hypothesis: Top-three causal-module coverage is more reliable when every counted directional target is supported by at least two distinct publications.
results.body: R246 with at least two distinct drug-decrease publications per counted target
results.mechanism_rationale: Publication independence reduces repeated-extraction artifacts while preserving multi-target disease-relative coverage.
results.trapi_notes: The positive paths are TRAPI-expressible; distinct-publication aggregation, rank, cardinality, and ontology constraints require post-processing.
results.cypher:
MATCH (subject:Drug)-[binding:DIRECTLY_PHYSICALLY_INTERACTS_WITH]->
      (gene:Gene)
MATCH (subject)-[effect:AFFECTS]->(gene)
MATCH (gene)-[evidence:MINER_GENE_DISEASE_EVIDENCE]->(object:Disease)
WHERE effect.qualified_predicate = 'biolink:causes'
  AND effect.object_aspect_qualifier = 'activity_or_abundance'
  AND effect.object_direction_qualifier = 'decreased'
  AND evidence._miner_disease_rank <= 3
  AND coalesce(object._miner_disease_descendant_degree, 0) <= 500
  AND object._miner_disease_superclass_degree >= 1
  AND object.id STARTS WITH 'MONDO:'

UNWIND coalesce(effect.publications, []) AS publication
WITH subject, object, gene,
     collect(DISTINCT publication) AS provenance_values
WHERE size(provenance_values) >= 2

WITH subject, object, count(DISTINCT gene) AS targeted_genes
WHERE targeted_genes >= 2
RETURN DISTINCT subject.id AS subject_id, object.id AS object_id

results.body: R246 with at least two binding primary sources per counted target
results.mechanism_rationale: Independent binding databases strengthen physical target assignment while directional effects remain text-mined.

results.name: SIGNOR-only top-three causal-module holdout
results.hypothesis: A curated SIGNOR-only directional-effect holdout tests whether ranked-module performance survives removal of the dominant text-mining channel.
results.body: R246 requiring SIGNOR as primary source for each counted decrease edge
results.mechanism_rationale: Curated directional effects remove text-mining dependence, but graph coverage is expected to be sparse.
results.trapi_notes: The positive paths are TRAPI-expressible; source, rank, cardinality, and ontology constraints require post-processing.

      (gene:Gene)
MATCH (subject)-[effect:AFFECTS]->(gene)
MATCH (gene)-[evidence:MINER_GENE_DISEASE_EVIDENCE]->(object:Disease)
WHERE effect.qualified_predicate = 'biolink:causes'
  AND effect.object_aspect_qualifier = 'activity_or_abundance'
